# Circular-segment area centroid reference vectors for JTS Curve EPIC (#1195, ARC_AREA_CENTROID).
#
# Area centroid of the circular segment between an arc and its chord; CircularArcs.segmentCentroid is the per-arc moment feeding CurvePolygon's area centroid. Covers minor/major arcs, CW & CCW sweeps, extreme radii (1e-3..1e4, sweeps >= 10 deg to stay clear of the near-flat instability), and arcs whose mid control point is not the angular midpoint (the segment depends only on the chord and which arc, so the centroid is mid-independent).
#

# exact-arithmetic oracle (OCaml + Zarith/GMP), mode ARC_AREA_CENTROID. Built by CI:

#   binary sha256 8d86bb4e3d4157795b4dfa7791e7aa8ce638d6741fa455f16aced407d3977fe8.
# Every expected value below is the oracle's verdict. The oracle is not
# vendored and is not a build dependency; these committed vectors are the
# durable, reproducible proof artifact a JTS implementation is pinned to.

#
